name: 金庸梦
group_note: finished an interrupted conversion (leftover static keywords across multiple files including master.lpc); reimplemented efun::tail() with read_file+explode+slice (§6.2); boots clean. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc; fixed the same euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc (create()/make_body()/howmany_user() all changed to seteuid(ROOT_UID)); fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds and dropped a nonsensical name[j]+=128 mutation left over from a GBK high-bit assumption; guarded adm/daemons/securityd.lpc's get_status() against a not-yet-initialized wiz_status/wiz_levels reentrant-compile crash. Found two new bugs: cmds/usr/quit.lpc called environment(me)->query(...) unguarded, crashing *Bad argument 1 to call_other() whenever a player quits with a nil environment (guarded all three call sites); adm/simul_efun/message.lpc's tell_room(ob,str,exclude) wrapper passes the omitted varargs exclude straight to message()'s 4th argument as raw int 0 instead of an empty array -- crashes the FIRST tell_room() call in the game (the welcome room's own create()), a known shared-wrapper bug already cataloged as AGENTS.md §7.12, fixed with the documented `exclude || ({})` pattern. Admin seeded into data/securityd.o's wiz_status mapping (CRLF-paired encoding here, not the CR-only per-key encoding seen in the hy/hy5 lineage -- still edited with binary-mode file I/O for safety). Registration through world-entry, look/score/quit and admin recognition all cleanly verified with no residual banner-timing flakiness.
